name: Shapesoda
original_description:
Vectorize images: PNG/JPG to SVG, PDF, EPS, DXF.

Attach a logo, icon, illustration, sticker or scan and ask Shapesoda to make it a vector. Shapesoda traces the image into clean shapes with exact colors and shows the result right in the chat: a before/after slider, the size and number of colors, and buttons to download SVG, PDF, EPS, DXF or PNG or copy the SVG code.

In the Shapesoda window you can change the settings and see the result update: image type (artwork, sharp pixel art, photo), input quality, transparent background (keep, white or a color), number of colors (two colors, a fixed palette you edit, or unlimited) and smoothness. "Open in editor" continues on shapesoda.com with the full editor.

Who it is for: designers, marketers, makers and small businesses who need a logo as SVG for a website or Figma, a cut file for Cricut, Silhouette or a vinyl cutter, a DXF for laser cutting, or a PDF/EPS for a print shop.

Limitations: Shapesoda converts existing raster images; it does not generate new images, edit photos or upscale. Input formats: PNG, JPEG, WebP, BMP, GIF and TIFF up to 10 MB; large images are downscaled to about 4 megapixels. Results and the uploaded file are kept for 24 hours and then deleted; images are never used to train models. Photos can be vectorized, but the result is a stylized vector, not a photo.
